|lore=Mara Jade posed as a dancer at Jabba’s Palace in an attempt to complete her master’s task and kill Luke. '''Musician'''. '''Spy'''. Unable to convince Jabba to take her on his skiff.
|game_text=Deploys only to a site as an Undercover spy. Reduces Luke's forfeit and immunity to attrition by 2 while present. During opponent's control phase, Arica may "break cover" to fire one weapon (for free). Immune to attrition < 4.

|strategy=[[Mara Jade]], the Emperor's hand, went undercover and posed as a dancer for crime lord [[Jabba]] the Hutt. This identity was used from the time of The Empire Strikes Back till shortly after [[Jabba]]'s demise.

As "[[Arica]]," Mara was commanded by the Emperor to assassinate [[Luke Skywalker]]. She planned to eliminate him as he worked to rescue the fallen [[Han Solo]]. The final [[Arica]] card image was suggested by depictions of [[Arica]] in stories published by Dark Horse Comics.<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/reflections2/dark/small/arica.html</ref>
|combos=* [[Arica]] + [[Nevar Yalnal]]<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?cardId=130 Scomp Link Access: Arica (Dark)], scomp.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020223233/https://swccg.com/snapshots/scomp/card-130.html Internet Archive].</ref>
|rulings=* If [[Arica]] breaks cover at [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]]'s site and [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him{{!}}There Is Good In Him]] on table, [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] is captured before [[Arica]] fires her weapon.<ref name="scomp" />
* May persona replace DS Mara only at a site ([[Arica]] still goes [[Undercover (Dark){{!}}Undercover]]).
* May be persona replaced (will no longer be [[Undercover (Dark){{!}}Undercover]]).
* If breaking cover to fire a repeating weapon (e.g. [[Light Repeating Blaster Rifle]]), it may fire repeatedly but only the first shot is free.
